entries.name: Get Application Info
entries.description: Retrieve general information about the UniFi Network application.

entries.name: List Local Sites
entries.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of local sites managed by this Network application.
Site ID is required for other UniFi Network API calls.

entries.name: List Devices Pending Adoption
entries.description: Retrieve a paginated list of devices pending adoption, including basic device information.

entries.name: List Adopted Devices
entries.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all adopted devices on a site, including basic device information.

entries.name: Adopt Devices
entries.description: Adopt a device to a site.

entries.name: Remove (Unadopt) Device
entries.description: Removes (unadopts) an adopted device from the site. If the device is online, it will be reset to factory defaults.

entries.name: Get Adopted Device Details
entries.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific adopted device, including firmware versioning, uplink state, details about device features and interfaces (ports, radios) and other key attributes.

entries.name: Execute Adopted Device Action
entries.description: Perform an action on an specific adopted device. The request body must include the action name and any applicable input arguments.

entries.name: Execute Port Action
entries.description: Perform an action on a specific device port. The request body must include the action name and any applicable input arguments.

entries.name: Get Latest Adopted Device Statistics
entries.description: Retrieve the latest real-time statistics of a specific adopted device, such as uptime, data transmission rates, CPU and memory utilization.

entries.name: List Connected Clients
entries.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all connected clients on a site, including physical devices (computers, smartphones) and active VPN connections.

entries.name: Get Connected Client Details
entries.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific connected client, including name, IP address, MAC address, connection type and access information.

entries.name: Execute Client Action
entries.description: Perform an action on a specific connected client. The request body must include the action name and any applicable input arguments.

entries.name: List Networks
entries.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all Networks on a site.

entries.name: Create Network
entries.description: Create a new network on a site.

entries.name: Delete Network
entries.description: Delete an existing network on a site.

entries.name: Get Network Details
entries.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific network.

entries.name: Update Network
entries.description: Update an existing network on a site.

entries.name: Get Network References
entries.description: Retrieve references to a specific network.

entries.name: List Wifi Broadcasts

entries.name: List Countries
entries.description:
Returns ISO-standard country codes and names,
used for region-based configuration or regulatory compliance.

entries.name: List DPI Applications
entries.description: Lists DPI-recognized applications grouped under categories. Useful for firewall or traffic analytics integration.

entries.name: List DPI Application Categories
entries.description: Returns predefined Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) application categories used for traffic identification and filtering.

entries.name: List Device Tags
entries.description: Returns all device tags defined within a site, which can be used for WiFi Broadcast assignments.

entries.name: List Radius Profiles
entries.description: Returns available RADIUS authentication profiles, including configuration origin metadata.

entries.name: List VPN Servers
entries.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all VPN servers on a site.

entries.name: List Site-To-Site VPN Tunnels
entries.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all site-to-site VPN tunnels on a site.

entries.name: List WAN Interfaces
entries.description:
Returns available WAN interface definitions for a given site,
including identifiers and names. Useful for network and NAT configuration.
